findings.resolution: Mapped this-study observations and external comparisons to EPMA, MODES and COMPARE.

findings.resolution: Extended mapping to in-situ and ex-situ runs, recovered-product SEM and interpretation with qualitative redox limitations.

findings.finding: Nine boolean/integer substitutions passed initial validator equality, including qualification, replicate count, lineage and rehashed-record fields.
findings.resolution: Canonical typed comparison plus strict entry validation; independent regressions now reject the original cases and additional float/nested-policy variants.

findings.finding: Nested tuples were accepted as JSON lists by canonical serialization.
findings.resolution: Recursive strict JSON-type validation rejects tuples, sets, non-string keys and other unsupported containers. Three independent tuple regressions pass.

source_review_basis: Final original source audit, retained main Methods and SI/table evidence already acquired; no new source acquisition. Critical source predicates and all conflict strings/locators/gates independently compared. This is not a second complete reading of every source asset.
residual_limitations: All ten source conflicts remain unresolved and block affected real bindings.
Source historical sample-parent associations remain unknown; synthetic dependency order does not establish them.
Validator accepts only explicit fixed synthetic bookkeeping instances and rejects real execution; no production signatures or fresh experimental evidence are validated.
Main and Extended Data figure pixels remain unverified and logged access holds remain in force.
No scientific software, instrument, press, heater, gas, laser or X-ray system was operated.
export_integrity_scope: Final exact-byte allowlist verification is a separate freeze check after this report is written; it does not alter the static-design approval scope. No external writes are authorized by this report.
